extracted.intended_audience: Office of Security / Administration & Training staff preparing data for an OS reply to OMB Circular A-44 (Revised)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit data for inclusion in the Office of Security's reply to implementation of OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), responding to a request (memorandum of 13 Nov 1970 as modified by DD/S 70-4530) by reporting items under specified sections (Management Effectiveness Goals and Cost Reduction Goals) and attaching branch memoranda that itemize changes and impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals (Section I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report items under Section 1, 'Management Effectiveness Goals'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example from staff: 'this Staff has only one item to report under Section 1, "Management Effectiveness Goals"' — describe changes that increase management effectiveness (e.g., scheduling changes that allow one Training Officer to deliver a program previously requiring two). Explain the operational effect such as releasing personnel to perform other duties or briefings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Reduction Goals (Section II)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report items under Section II, 'Cost Reduction Goals', showing cost savings or indicate none exist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If there are no cost reductions to report, submit a negative report (as in the example: 'and submits a negative report on Section II, "Cost Reduction Goals"'). If cost reductions exist, quantify them and explain how they were achieved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attach branch memorandum itemizing changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Include an attached memorandum from the relevant branch (e.g., Chief, Training Branch) that itemizes scheduling/timing changes and their staffing/cost/effectiveness impacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The example attachment 'itemizes a change in the scheduling and timing of the Security Education Program and has resulted in one Training Officer being able to give the entire Program where two were previously required.' The attachment should state whether the change produced cost reduction, and describe any management effectiveness improvements (e.g., freed personnel for other tasks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond according to the requesting memorandum and references
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare the reply in accordance with the requester's memorandum and any modifying directives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow and cite the controlling request (example text: 'In accordance with the request contained in your memorandum of 13 November 1970 as modified by DD/S 70-4530, dated 16 November 1970'). Include appropriate routing (e.g., 'MEMORANDUM FOR: Chief, Executive and Planning Division'), approval/classification markings, and dates to show compliance with the request.
